prompt: Use case: identity-preserving game-animation refinement. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet in a STRICT 3-column by 4-row layout (12 frames, chronological left-to-right then down), overall landscape 4:3 aspect. Every cell is a WIDE 16:9 shot, not square. Leave at least 6% alpha padding between all cells. Reference 1 is Andy's exact identity and original resting pose. Reference 2 is the previous imperfect animation: improve it, do NOT copy its cropped elbows or inconsistent positioning. Each wide cell shows identical camera and scale: Andy centered at x=50%, head top y=8%, resting forearms bottom y=86%. Torso, neck base, resting left arm and head size stay LOCKED to identical coordinates in every cell; only his right arm (viewer LEFT) and subtle sipping mouth change. Preserve exact original face, hairstyle, black sleeveless shirt, forearm tattoo and bracelets, photographic skin texture and lighting. No face redesign, no drifting body, no zoom. Include the ENTIRE elbow and hand at ALL times with ample transparent space left of his body. Generic GREEN beer bottle with blank cream label. Resting bottle starts at x=12%, bottom y=90%, as if in a game table's left cupholder; no table or actual holder drawn. His right hand reaches to that bottle with an anatomically connected full-length arm. Frame 1 original resting pose with bottle at left. 2 right hand moving toward bottle, palm open. 3 fingers firmly wrapped around bottle at same left position. 4 bottle lifted halfway toward chest with connected wrist/elbow. 5 bottle close to mouth. 6 rim exactly at lips with mild upward tilt. 7 sustained sip, same head position. 8 bottle lowering to chest. 9 bottle lowering down and left. 10 bottle taken below lower boundary, hand partly lowering, NO severed elbow. 11 empty right hand returning to original forearm rest. 12 exact original resting pose, no bottle. Do not move left hand, shoulders or torso between frames. Wide consistent framing must allow reaching the cupholder position without cropping. No text, no cell outlines, no background, no extra limbs or floating bottle. Clear correct hand grip and finger occlusion. Photographic cohesive sequential frames, not a collection of unrelated poses.
discarded: Malformed lower-left pose contains an extra arm; not used. Lower-middle pose unused.
method: Seven valid poses extracted with head registration. Return reuses lifting poses in reverse; no crossfades or face warping.
limitations: Discrete poses still have minor face/torso differences; cupholder-to-hand alignment remains approximate.
